d: An anthropomorphic canine with a muscular build, featuring snowy white fur across the body, a bushy tail, and long drooping ears. The face has a mature expression with narrow, almond-shaped eyes of a golden-yellow hue. The outfit consists of a bronze-colored breastplate with gold accents, a lime-green sash wrapped around the waist, dark grey baggy trousers with a teal trim, and grey armored boots with bronze knee guards. Signature details include a silver metallic shoulder guard on the left side and a pair of short blades held in the hands. BODY COLOR: snowy white
